captions.detailed: A floor-standing rectangular air purifier unit styled with a clean light-gray finish. It features a hinged rear access door for filter replacement, accented with dark gray hinges on one side and a dark gray handle latch on the other. The main body has rounded vertical edges, presenting a modern, minimalist residential appliance aesthetic.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a rectangular floor air purifier. The model should include a main housing with rounded vertical corners, a rear filter door mounted via dual vertical hinges on one side, and a simple rectangular latch handle on the opposite side.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject representing the purifier. It creates a main body using a Box primitive with filleted vertical edges. A rear door is constructed as a thinner Box, placed in a cutout or offset on the back face. Two cylindrical hinges are modeled along one vertical edge of the door, and a small rectangular prism is added on the opposite side to serve as the handle latch.
